subject: PO + DPA execution steps for EdgeWorks
messages:
From: Julia Sullivan <julia.sullivan@edgeworks.com>
To: irene_choi@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-09-15T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Vendor setup: PO routing, DPA & SOC2 link request

Hi Irene / Laura,

We're ready to move EdgeWorks onto Redwood for the pilot. Procurement asked me to collect a few items so we can create a PO and complete our vendor intake:

- Vendor intake form (attached): please confirm we can return completed fields.
- Executed DPA or preferred signing flow (DocuSign link is easiest).
- SOC 2 report or public link to the latest report.
- Current subprocessor list or a link to one.
- Bill-to and remit instructions so we can route the PO.

Can you confirm who on your side will sign the DPA and whether we should expect a countersigned DocuSign envelope or signature after we return the PO? Also: what is Redwood’s standard PO terms (net-30/45/60) and billing contact?

Attachments: EdgeWorks_Vendor_Form.pdf

Thanks — happy to set a quick 20-min call if helpful.

Best,
Julia Sullivan
Vendor Manager | EdgeWorks Inc.
julie.sullivan@edgeworks.com
+1 415-555-0142
From: irene_choi@redwood.ai
To: Julia Sullivan <julia.sullivan@edgeworks.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-09-15T10:25:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor setup: PO routing, DPA & SOC2 link request

Hi Julia — thanks for the clear checklist. Quick answers below and I’ve attached the DPA (Redwood_DPA_v1.2.pdf) for your review.

- Vendor intake: please complete the attached PDF and return to procure@edgeworks.com and cc billing@redwood.dev (we’ll accept scanned PDF).
- DPA: we can do DocuSign. I’ve initiated a draft envelope but if you prefer to attach a redline, we’ll route to legal. DocuSign link will be provided once legal signs.
- SOC 2: public report is here — https://redwood-inference.s3.amazonaws.com/compliance/soc2-report-2026.pdf (PDF).
- Subprocessors: current list is published at https://redwood.ai/subprocessors (we’ll send a snapshot if you need it embedded in the contract).
- PO & billing: please email the PO to billing@redwood.dev with the PO number in the subject and indicate net-30 unless you’ve been quoted alternate terms. Remit: Redwood Inference, 101 Market St, Suite 200, San Francisco CA 94105. Wires to: Redwood Bank Solutions (details on the invoice).

I’m looping in Ben (sales) and Laura (legal ops) to expedite DPA review if you attach a redline. If it’s straightforward we can countersign in 1–2 business days; if there are legal edits, plan for 3–5 business days.

Attachments: Redwood_DPA_v1.2.pdf

Regards,
Irene Choi
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwood.ai
From: Julia Sullivan <julia.sullivan@edgeworks.com>
To: irene_choi@redwood.ai
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-09-16T08:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor setup: PO routing, DPA & SOC2 link request

Thanks Irene — received the DPA. Our legal has a small requested change to Section 6 (data deletion window) to tighten the retention window to 45 days for archived customer data; Redwood’s template currently references 90 days for backups. Can your legal review that specific clause?

Also: would you prefer we mark up the attached DPA PDF and return, or should we upload a redline to DocuSign? We’d like to keep the signature flow electronic if possible.

Lastly: confirm whether the published subprocessor list at /subprocessors is the authoritative snapshot you’d include if we reference it in the contract, or if you generate a static appendix at signing.

Julia
From: ben_carter@redwood.ai
To: Julia Sullivan <julia.sullivan@edgeworks.com>
Cc: irene_choi@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-09-17T11:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor setup: PO routing, DPA & SOC2 link request

Hi Julia — Ben from Sales here. Laura in Legal reviewed the requested change and we can accept the 45-day archived-data retention amendment as a limited redline; attached is Redwood_DPA_redline_EdgeWorks.pdf with the precise language.

Next steps:
1) I’ll upload the redlined DPA to DocuSign and create an envelope addressed to the EdgeWorks signees. Expect the DocuSign link in this thread shortly: https://app.docusign.com/envelope/ABC123-EdgeWorks
2) Please send your completed EdgeWorks_Vendor_Form.pdf and the PO to billing@redwood.dev and include the PO number in the subject. Standard terms are net-30 unless you’ve been given a custom payment schedule in procurement.
3) For subprocessors: the public page is authoritative for live notice (https://redwood.ai/subprocessors) and we’ll capture a snapshot in the DPA as an appendix at execution.

Attachments: Redwood_DPA_redline_EdgeWorks.pdf

If you’d like a short call to close the signature and PO steps, I’m available today 2–4pm PT. Otherwise, we’ll proceed with DocuSign.

Cheers,
Ben Carter
Senior Account Manager | Redwood Inference
